title: Page 5
content_zh:
他关了房内所有灯光，只留墙角的一盏小夜灯，侧过身子凝视着她秀丽的容颜。
“佳颖。”
“……”她微微侧脸，看着他拿下眼镜后更显英俊的面孔，高挺的鼻梁、深邃的眼眸……
她不自觉地盯着他的双唇看，一颗心在昏暗的光线下跳得好快，不晓得下一秒即将发生--
“晚安。”
“嗯……嗯？”心跳漏了一拍，突然减速放慢。她眨眨眼睛望着他，表情有些愕然。觉得事情好像不该是这样发展的……
“怎么了？”他笑看着她。自己说错了什么吗？
“没有，晚安。”她也对他微微一笑，但这笑容里却隐约藏着一点说不出口的失落感，没想到她的新婚之夜就在短短的数十秒里，用一声“晚安”划下句点。
这不是她想象中的新婚之夜啊！原本她以为两人应该会先深情款款地对望，然后他慢慢地靠近……她便自然而然地闭上眼，接受他温柔的亲吻，和温柔的拥抱？
结果，他居然合上眼，就这么睡着了？
她拉了拉胸口的被子，一脸苦恼的望着躺在身边的丈夫，向来憋不住心事的她忍不住开了口--
“天云。”
“嗯？”他睁开眼看她。
“今天……是我们第一次同床呢！”她害羞地说，手指不时还绞着被子的边缘，心想他是不是没注意到这是他们首次同床共枕眠呢？
“是啊，是不是身边忽然多了一个人，感觉不太习惯？”他笑问，猜测她可能是因为自己的存在而感到不太自在，眼神看来怯生生的。
虽然他也不太习惯身旁多躺了一个人，但毕竟是自己睡惯的床，他的感觉总没她那样陌生。
“不是，我只是觉得今晚好像才是我们的新婚之夜。”她连忙否认，暗示性地提醒他今晚很特别，就这么睡着好像不太符合新婚夫妻之间应该有的那种甜蜜感觉耶。
他至少该抱抱她或给她一个晚安吻不是吗？她看电影里都是那样演的……
“这么说也没错，你结婚后就出国去念书，一晃眼都过了三年了。”他想想也是，却是以一种觉得光阴似箭的口吻回应她含羞带怯的暗示，记得当年在结婚当晚他还特地让她回到关家去住，把握出国前的最后一个晚上和父母多聚聚，自己则一个人留在饭店里过夜……
“快睡吧，你今天搭了那么久的飞机一定很累。”他心无邪念地帮她把弄乱的被子拉好，要她早点入眠，好好休息。

在杜天云眼里，关佳颖只是个年纪比他弟弟还小的小女生而已，因此对着她那张像天使一样纯净稚嫩的脸孔，自然不会萌生什么多余的想法，否则他岂不成了禽兽不如的家伙。
“呃！还好啦……”关佳颖愣了下，没想到他居然会说出跟母亲一样的话来！
天晓得她一点都不想从他身上得到这种“母爱”，而且下午才在娘家补过一顿眠而已，她现在真的没那么困。
“晚安。”他当她只是客气的说法，摸摸她柔顺的发丝，温柔地哄她入睡。
“晚安。”她这才不得已地闭上眼，哀怨地把被子拉到下巴。
对于这个绕了一圈又回到原点的结果，她实在有些失望，但也不好意思再把话说得更明白了，毕竟她是是个女人呀……
悄悄转头，她静静地看着躺在身旁的男人，用欣赏的目光描绘着他好看的侧脸，弯着唇，无声地笑着。
尽管心情有些无奈，但看着爱慕多年的男人就躺在自己身边，成为她名正言顺的另一半，她还是有种美梦成真的喜悦。
见他呼吸平稳，似乎已经熟睡，她把枕头往他的方向挪了一点，身子也往他靠近一些，似有若无地感受到他的体温……
光是这样挨在他身边，她便感觉自己已经得到梦寐以求的幸福了……
隔日清晨，杜天云不是被生理时钟叫醒，而是感觉到一股沉甸甸的力量压在他半边身体上。
他睁开眼，掀开被子--发现是关佳颖正缩着身子枕在他胸口，手脚半跨在他身上，把他当抱枕似地依偎着。
他看了看身边空出的大半边床位，和这不知何时钻进被子底下的女人，突然觉得眼前的情况有些好笑，奇怪她干么放着宽敞的床铺不睡，偏要闷着被子窝在他身边……
是被子不够暖，所以她才偎近他身边取暖吗？
杜天云莞尔想着，抬头看了眼时间，比平常还早按掉床头的闹钟，再小心翼翼地挪动那个压在他身上的女人，拿枕头取代他的胸口，枕在她的颈下，不想惊扰她的睡眠。
关佳颖咕哝了声，似乎在睡梦中也察觉到丈夫和枕头的差别，抗议地轻皱了下眉头，但没有睁开眼。
杜天云花了几分钟才从她紧紧相依的睡姿中脱身，下床盥洗、更衣……
“我吵醒你了？”他换好衬衫从衣物间里走出来，就看到她坐在床上，一脸困意地揉着眼皮。
她循声抬头，对着他微笑，摇摇头，下床走向他。
“你要上班啦？”

“吃过早餐就出门，你再睡一会儿。”他看她一副睡眼惺忪的模样，神情带点茫然的傻气，唇角又不自觉扬起。
很奇怪的，虽然他无论心情好坏，通常都会以和颜悦色的面目对人，把和蔼可亲当成一层保护色，隐匿起自己的心思，教人看不透他的真正想法。但是在见到关佳颖的时候，他的笑意却是自然而然地由心底浮现，没有半点虚伪地感到愉快。
“我帮你打。”见他拿在手上的领带，她马上自告奋勇地要替他服务。
“我自己来就行了。”他平时做惯的动作，没有必要劳烦她。
“可是我想帮你打领带。”她盯着他手里的领带，语调马上哀怨地降低一截，觉得这应该是她身为人妻要做的甜蜜工作之一才对。
“那就麻烦你喽。”听到她那种失望中又掺杂渴望的语气，他当然不忍继续坚持，立刻把手中的领带交出来。
让她感到开心也是他疼爱她的方法之一。
“晚上你几点回来？”她笑着接过领带，在他领口绕一圈，边打还不忘边跟老公聊聊天，心想自己今晚或许可以亲自下厨做顿爱心晚餐哩。
“我今晚有应酬，可能会晚一点。”他稍微抬高下巴，方便她动作。
“哦，那就是不回来吃晚饭了……”她口气里有掩不住的失望，拉下手中的领带，又绕一遍重打。
第2章(2)
见她抿着唇，细眉轻蹙，他心中竟莫名地泛起一股罪恶感，觉得冷落她是种罪……
“中午要不要到公司来？我们一起吃午餐。”他转而提议共进午餐，希望能让她觉得好过一点。
“好呀，那我中午去找你。”她一听，立刻露出开心的笑容，手上的动作也变得轻快。“我会让司机过来接你。”他想她还真像个小孩，什么情绪都写在脸上，一点也不懂得隐藏。
或许就是她的这份单纯无邪，让他觉得和她相处起来十分轻松自在，可是也相对感到歉疚，因为他并不爱她，却要在她面前虚构爱的假象，利用她这颗棋子来促成大局，达到自己私心的目的……
“嗯。”不知道丈夫真正的心思，关佳颖笑得灿烂无比，觉得他中午特地陪她吃饭是因为爱她，所以不忍心让她整天都孤伶伶地一个人吃饭。
两人相视而笑，她继续低头完成动作，但表情却愈来愈困惑、挫折，眉间又再度靠拢……
content_en:
He turned off all the lights in the room, leaving only a night light in the corner, and turned sideways to stare at her beautiful face.
"Jia Ying."
"..." She turned her face slightly and looked at his more handsome face after taking off his glasses, his tall nose and deep eyes...
She stared at his lips unconsciously, her heart beating so fast in the dim light, not knowing what was about to happen in the next second -
"Good night."
"Hmm...huh?" His heart skipped a beat and suddenly slowed down. She blinked and looked at him with a somewhat stunned expression. I feel like things shouldn't develop like this...
"What's wrong?" He looked at her with a smile. Did you say something wrong?
"No, good night." She also smiled at him, but there was a vague sense of loss that could not be expressed in her smile. Unexpectedly, her wedding night ended with a "good night" in just tens of seconds.
This was not the wedding night she had imagined! Originally, she thought that the two of them would look at each other affectionately at first, and then he would slowly approach... Then she would naturally close her eyes and accept his gentle kiss and gentle embrace?
As a result, he actually closed his eyes and fell asleep like that?
She pulled the quilt on her chest and looked at her husband lying next to her with a troubled expression. She could not help but speak -
"Tianyun."
"Huh?" He opened his eyes and looked at her.
"Today...is our first time sleeping together!" She said shyly, her fingers twirling the edge of the quilt from time to time, wondering if he hadn't noticed that this was their first time sleeping together?
"Yeah, are you not used to having someone around you suddenly?" He asked with a smile, guessing that she might feel uncomfortable because of his presence, and her eyes looked timid.
Although he was not used to having another person lying next to him, after all, it was the bed he was used to sleeping on, so it didn't feel as strange to him as she did.
"No, I just feel like tonight is our wedding night." She quickly denied it, hinting to remind him that tonight was special, and falling asleep like this didn't seem to be in line with the sweet feeling that a newlywed couple should have.
He should at least give her a hug or a kiss goodnight, shouldn't he? She acted like that in movies...
"That's right. After you got married, you went abroad to study, and three years have passed in the blink of an eye." He thought about it, but he responded to her shy hint in a tone that felt like time flies. He remembered that on the night of the wedding, he specifically asked her to go back to Guan's house to spend the last night before going abroad to spend more time with her parents, while he stayed alone in the hotel for the night...
"Go to sleep. You must be very tired after taking such a long flight today." He helped her pull the messed up quilt innocently, asking her to go to sleep early and have a good rest.
In Du Tianyun's eyes, Guan Jiaying is just a little girl who is younger than his brother. Therefore, facing her pure and childish face like an angel, he will naturally not have any unnecessary thoughts, otherwise he will become worse than a beast.
"Uh! It's okay..." Guan Jiaying was stunned for a moment, but she didn't expect that he would actually say the same thing as her mother!
God knows she doesn't want this kind of "motherly love" from him at all, and she just had some sleep at her parents' house in the afternoon. She really isn't that sleepy now.
"Good night." He thought she was just saying it politely. He touched her silky hair and gently coaxed her to sleep.
"Good night." She had no choice but to close her eyes and pull the quilt up to her chin sadly.
She was really disappointed with the result of going full circle and returning to the starting point, but she was too embarrassed to explain it more clearly. After all, she was a woman...
Turning her head quietly, she quietly looked at the man lying next to her, describing his beautiful profile with admiration, curling her lips and smiling silently.
Although I feel a little helpless, I still feel loved for many yearsWith the man lying next to her and becoming her legitimate other half, she still felt happy that her dream had come true.
Seeing that his breathing was steady and he seemed to be sleeping soundly, she moved the pillow a little closer to him and moved closer to him, vaguely feeling his body temperature...
Just being next to him like this made her feel like she had achieved the happiness she had dreamed of...
The next morning, Du Tianyun was not woken up by his biological clock, but felt a heavy force pressing on half of his body.
He opened his eyes and lifted the quilt - and found that Guan Jiaying was curled up and pillowing on his chest, half straddling him with her arms and legs, cuddling against him as if he were a pillow.
He looked at most of the empty beds next to him and the woman who had slipped under the quilt at some point. He suddenly felt that the situation in front of him was a bit funny. He wondered why she was not sleeping on the spacious bed, but she was sulking next to him under the quilt...
Was the quilt not warm enough, so she leaned close to him to keep warm?
Du Tianyun smiled and thought, looked up at the time, and pressed the alarm clock on the bedside earlier than usual. Then he carefully moved the woman on top of him, replaced his chest with a pillow, and put it under her neck, not wanting to disturb her sleep.
Guan Jiaying muttered, as if she noticed the difference between her husband and the pillow in her sleep, and frowned slightly in protest, but did not open her eyes.
It took Du Tianyun a few minutes to get out of her sleeping position and get out of bed to wash and change clothes...
"Did I wake you up?" He changed his shirt and walked out of the dressing room, and saw her sitting on the bed, rubbing her eyelids sleepily.
She raised her head following the sound, smiled at him, shook her head, got out of bed and walked towards him.
"Are you going to work?"
"We'll go out after breakfast. You can sleep a little longer." He looked at her sleepy look, with a dazed look on her face, and the corners of her lips raised unconsciously.
It's strange that no matter whether he is in a good or bad mood, he usually faces people with a pleasant face, using his affability as a protective layer to hide his thoughts and make others unable to see through his true thoughts. But when he saw Guan Jiaying, his smile appeared naturally from the bottom of his heart, feeling happy without any pretense.
"I'll help you tie it." Seeing the tie in his hand, she immediately volunteered to serve him.
"I can just do it myself." He did what he usually did, so there was no need to bother her.
"But I want to help you tie your tie." She stared at the tie in his hand, and her tone immediately dropped sadly, thinking that this should be one of the sweet tasks she had to do as a wife.
"Then I'll trouble you." Hearing her tone of disappointment mixed with longing, of course he couldn't bear to insist on and immediately handed over the tie in his hand.
Making her happy is one of the ways he loves her.
"What time will you be back tonight?" She smiled and took the tie, circling it around his collar, chatting with her husband while not forgetting it, thinking that she might be able to cook a loving dinner tonight.
"I have a social event tonight, so it may be a little late." He raised his chin slightly to make it easier for her to move.
"Oh, that means I won't be back for dinner..." She couldn't hide the disappointment in her tone, pulled down the tie in her hand, and tied it again.
Chapter 2(2)
Seeing her pursed lips and frowning, he felt an inexplicable sense of guilt in his heart, feeling that it was a sin to neglect her...
"Would you like to come to the company at noon? Let's have lunch together." He then suggested having lunch together, hoping to make her feel better.
"Okay, then I'll find you at noon." Upon hearing this, she immediately smiled happily and the movements of her hands became brisk. "I'll ask the driver to pick you up." He thought that she was really like a child, with all her emotions written on her face and not knowing how to hide them at all.
Perhaps it was her innocence that made him feel comfortable getting along with her.He was very relaxed and at ease, but he also felt relatively guilty because he didn't love her, but he wanted to make up the illusion of love in front of her, using her as a pawn to promote the overall situation and achieve his own selfish goals...
"Yeah." Not knowing her husband's true thoughts, Guan Jiaying smiled brightly, thinking that he specially ate with her at noon because he loved her, so he couldn't bear to let her eat alone all day long.
The two looked at each other and smiled. She continued to lower her head to complete the action, but her expression became more and more confused and frustrated, and her eyebrows came closer again...
